title: MedSim - Yapay Zeka Destekli Vaka Simülasyonu
summary: MedSim is an AI-assisted virtual patient case-simulation web app for medical students, combining a Flask backend with Gemini-driven patient dialogue. Its hemogram module trains and loads an SDV CTGANSynthesizer to produce synthetic hematology (IDA) patient data and validates it with sdmetrics' DiagnosticReport and QualityReport.
evidence: backend/Tahlil/src/hemogram_model.py:6-9 trains CTGANSynthesizer, generates data, then runs sdmetrics DiagnosticReport/QualityReport; backend/app.py:103-105 loads saved model via CTGANSynthesizer.load
